WORKING NOTES

IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight black hair wears a heathered
gray cropped V-neck knit with navy
raglan sleeves, cream and red stripes,
and a large red letter S. Red cuffs peek
at the wrists. She wears dark low-rise
jeans. Her expression is calm and direct.
A plain white backdrop with soft, even
light. Palette of heather gray, navy, and
crimson. Collegiate and cozy, in the
style of a college knitwear catalog.
